name: lwe-ask
$comment: Every wrangler script that READS the config passes --x-new-config and runs from THIS directory, because the Worker config is cloudflare.config.ts (migrated from wrangler.toml with `cf migrate` on 2026-09-28) and that loader reads the working directory and refuses -c. That loader never walks up to the root cloudflare.config.ts, so wrangler can't pick up the site's config from here. wrangler is declared as a devDependency for the `cf` CLI alone, which reads a project's OWN manifest for its dev server; it references the root catalog, and check-wrangler verifies the installed resolution. `tail` is the exception and names the Worker instead: it refuses --x-new-config as an unknown argument (measured 2026-09-28, although `tail --x-new-config --help` exits 0), and with a positional name it reads no config and runs no build.
